newsitem.title: USA: BPA leaves Monday power prices mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: BPA leaves Monday power prices mostly unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Monday pre-schedulings at unchanged prices, the agency said Friday.
BPA offered Monday peak firm power at $16.00 per MWh and $18.00 for California-Oregon (COB) sales.
BPA also continued to offer non-firm power for Monday during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT at $8.00 per MWh.

Non-firm power at hours ending 0600 and 2300 on Monday was also unchanged at $10.00, while prices for hours ending 0700-0800 were steady $14.00 for COB, while Northwest prices fell by $1.00 to $12.00.
BPA also offered firm power during peak demand hours on Saturday at $13.00-15.00 and on Sunday at $12.00.
Non-firm power for Saturday and Sunday was offered at $8.00 during off-peak hours and $13.00-16.00 for on-peak.
